attributes.name: Red Flocked effect Timeless tradition Christmas bauble set, Pack of 3
attributes.description: Add texture and colour to your festive décor with this red flocked effect Timeless Tradition Christmas bauble set. The pack of 3 baubles features a soft flocked finish and can be used to decorate Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands and seasonal displays. Their rich red tone creates a traditional Christmas look while adding depth and interest to your decorations.
features: Pack of 3 Christmas baubles with a red flocked effect finish
Soft textured design adds depth to festive displays
Ideal for decorating Christmas trees, wreaths and garlands
Traditional red colour complements a variety of Christmas décor styles
